name: KDP Self-Publishing Launch Kit
description: Plan, research, and launch a Kindle Direct Publishing book — from niche validation to cover brief to launch week marketing calendar.
seoDescription: Validate a book niche, research keywords, outline your manuscript, create metadata, and build a launch marketing calendar for Amazon KDP — all with AI.
long_description:
Most self-published books never sell more than 100 copies. And the ones that do sell usually succeed for one reason: they were launched, not just uploaded.

This skill takes you from book idea to published product with a complete launch workflow built for Amazon KDP. It's not a writing coach (though it helps with outlines). It's a launch planner that treats a book like the product it is: researched, positioned, packaged, and promoted.

What you get:
- Niche validation: keyword research framework, competitive analysis of top 10 books in your category, demand signals, and estimated search volume
- Metadata optimization: title, subtitle, 7 backend keywords, and 2 book description variants (short for browse pages, long for the detail page)
- Chapter outline with reader psychology: what someone needs to believe after each chapter to keep reading
- Cover design brief with genre conventions, dimensions, typography rules, and a designer-ready spec sheet
- Launch calendar: 21-day book launch plan with pre-launch, launch week, and post-launch activations
- AMS ad starter framework: how to set up your first Amazon ad campaign with suggested keywords and bidding strategy
- Pricing strategy: how to price for category rank vs. revenue per sale

Perfect for creators who have expertise worth publishing but don't know the self-publishing game. Turns months of trial-and-error into a repeatable launch system.
author: CreatorSkills
